package store

import "context"

// Fixture for TestCtxThreading_ScannerFixture. Never compiled (*.go.txt).

type LocalStorage struct{}

// newBackgroundJob is the documented background entry point: exempt.
func newBackgroundJob() context.Context { return context.Background() }

func mintsTodo() context.Context { return context.TODO() }

func hop() context.Context { return mintsTodo() }

// --- safe forms ---

func (ls *LocalStorage) GetWidget(ctx context.Context, id string) (string, error) {
	_ = ctx
	return id, nil
}

func (ls *LocalStorage) ThreadsCtx(ctx context.Context) error {
	_, err := ls.GetWidget(ctx, "x")
	return err
}

func (ls *LocalStorage) UsesBackgroundJob(ctx context.Context) {
	_ = ctx
	_ = newBackgroundJob()
}

func (ls *LocalStorage) WithoutCancelKeepsValues(ctx context.Context) context.Context {
	return context.WithoutCancel(ctx)
}

// --- planted violations ---

func (ls *LocalStorage) DeleteWidget(id string) error { return nil }

func (ls *LocalStorage) DiscardsCtx(_ context.Context) error { return nil }

func (ls *LocalStorage) UnnamedCtx(context.Context) error { return nil }

func (ls *LocalStorage) SubstitutesDirect(ctx context.Context) context.Context {
	_ = ctx
	return context.Background()
}

func (ls *LocalStorage) SubstitutesViaHelper(ctx context.Context) context.Context {
	_ = ctx
	return mintsTodo()
}

func (ls *LocalStorage) SubstitutesTwoHops(ctx context.Context) context.Context {
	_ = ctx
	return ls.twoHops()
}

func (ls *LocalStorage) twoHops() context.Context { return hop() }
